steps.scale: A scale is a row of notes going up or down, one key after another. The {cScale} uses all the white keys from {c} to the next {c}: eight notes for five fingers. The trick: after {e}, the thumb passes under the hand to play {f}. Fingers 1 2 3, thumb under, 1 2 3 4 5.
steps.thumbUnder: First the tricky part: {c}, {d}, {e}, and the thumb under to {f}. Coming back, the middle finger crosses over the thumb to {e}.
steps.up: The whole scale going up. Keep your wrist level as the thumb passes under.
steps.down: And going down: 5 4 3 2 1, then 3 crosses over the thumb, 2 1.
steps.upDown: Up and down in time, one note per click.
steps.joyToTheWorld: Scales are everywhere in music: the first line of “Joy to the World” is the {cScale} going down.
